title: Board rework: choose the structure
question: Three structures for the board on phone and desktop, all in today's theme. Lock the one that best fits the shape brief. All three will be built as ?variant= prototypes on /board either way.

options.label: Pick up and place
options.thesis: Tap a todo to pick it up, then tap a Bucket to place it. Dragging does the same thing.
options.viewport: Phone: one Bucket fills the screen, and a strip of Bucket tabs with counts sits in the thumb zone. When you pick up a todo, the strip turns into drop targets. Desktop: all five columns, and the column headers become tap targets.
options.risk: A pick-up mode is new to most people, so the selected state has to be unmistakable.

options.label: Horizon ladder
options.thesis: All Buckets in one vertical list, nearest first, with one-step Sooner / Later buttons on each todo.
options.viewport: Phone: Today at the top, then week, month, year, and Inbox as sections with sticky headers. A chip row jumps to any section. Desktop: kanban columns with the same step buttons.
options.risk: Moving a todo several horizons at once takes several taps unless there is also a Move to menu.

options.label: Today first, pull from above
options.thesis: The phone opens on today. Broader Buckets live in a pull-up drawer, and you pull todos down into today.
options.viewport: Phone: the selected Bucket's list (Today by default) with a bottom drawer handle reading 'Pull from this week · 6'. Each todo has a Move menu. Desktop: kanban with today pinned wide on the right.
options.risk: Inbox and year feel secondary on a phone, which fits the brand but hides the planning view.
